item.description:
Swedish House Mafia "Tomorrowland Belgium 2025: Swedish House Mafia at Mainstage, Weekend 2 (DJ Mix)"
Dolby Atmos Music



As Tomorrowland 2025 has officially closed the chapter on arguably the most memorable edition to date, the festival has uploaded sets so fans can continue reliving the magic, including the mainstage masterclass from the Swedish House Mafia during weekend two.

When it comes to the Swedish House Mafia at Tomorrowland, you will not find a performance that the three have done on the grounds that hasn’t been iconic. Back for Tomorrowland 2025 to deliver more magic, after their extended show during weekend one, which was a more intimate performance at the Crystal Garden, they took to the mainstage on Friday during weekend two for their usual grandiose show. It’s been hard not to be able to go back and watch it, but thanks to Tomorrowland, viewers can now relive the magical hour on YouTube.

Playing in a different timeslot than usual, Axwell, Steve Angello, and Sebastian Ingrosso stepped away from their usual closing slot to play the hour that ushers in the nighttime. Wasting no time raising the energy, the three stepped onto the new mainstage with Axwell doing his famed introduction and they immediately opened with the John Alto remix of ‘Antidote‘ followed by a mashup of their track with A$AP Rocky ‘Frankenstein‘ and Angello’s ‘Hooligans,‘ then their iconic ‘Show Me Love‘ mashup and right after their rework of ‘Miaimi 2 Ibiza.‘

Later in the show, Sebastian Ingrosso played his new track, ‘A New Day‘ with Céline Dion. Which is a reimagining of Dion’s famous 2002 track ‘A New Day Has Come.‘ Then immediately after came one of the best moments of the set as halfway through the trio introduced a mashup of RÜFÜS DU SOL’s ‘Innerbloom‘ with ‘Payback.‘ As they neared the last 15 minutes of the set, they played their career-defining hit ‘Don’t You Worry Child‘ with the crowd singing every word over the track. Then they played their newest track, ‘Wait So Long‘, followed by an exciting ID which was mashed with ‘Heaven Takes You Home.‘ And in epic fashion, they finished the night off with ‘Calling (Lose My Mind)‘ mixed with ‘You Got The Love‘ and ‘I Wanna Dance With Somebody,‘ and then ultimately ‘One‘ as the closing track.
